eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Elmore, ID; at 5:53 PM on SEP 24, 2026 Effective until 7:53 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an activation of the Endangered Missing Person Alert system.  The Elmore County Sheriffs office is looking for Christian Vanbergen 8 year old male 5ft 2 inches tall 80 lbs brown hair brown eyes wearing a red shirt black pants and white shoes.  He was last seen in Mountain Home and Police believe he is with Danyell Vanbergen. They are believed to be in a 2020 Grey Ford Escape Idaho License plate 1AX037U.  If you have any information please contact the Elmore County Sheriffs office at 2085872121.
